title: Pausing and Skipping FilterDirect Shipments
content:
**Allowance.** A subscriber to FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions may skip a single shipment up to 2 times in any 12 months, or pause shipments up to 2 times in any 12 months for no more than 6 months each, when the request arrives at least 3 calendar days before the ship date; a later request applies from the following cycle.

**Pause limit.** A pause is accepted only while fewer than 2 pauses have been taken in the preceding 12 months.

**End of a pause.** A paused subscription resumes on the date its pause ends, which is set when the pause is taken; shipments also resume when the subscriber resumes them. A subscription still paused beyond 6 months is cancelled.

| Grade | Skips in any 12 months | Pauses in any 12 months | Longest pause | Notice before the ship date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 2 | 2 | 6 months | 3 days |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 2 | 2 | 6 months | 3 days |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 2 | 2 | 6 months | 3 days |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 2 | 2 | 6 months | 3 days |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 2 | 2 | 6 months | 3 days |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 2 | 2 | 6 months | 3 days |

### How skips and pauses are counted

Both counts run over a rolling window of 12 calendar months ending on the date the request is handled, and both are read from the subscription's own records rather than from the subscriber's recollection.

- **Pauses** are the pauses recorded on the subscription within the window.
- **Skips** are the changes within the window that moved the subscription's next ship date one shipment interval later.

### Pause limit, condition by condition

| Pauses recorded on the subscription in the preceding 12 months | Pause accepted? |
|---|---|
| 0 | Yes |
| 1 | Yes |
| 2 | No |

The same window applies to skips: with 2 skips already recorded in the 12 months, a further skip would go beyond the allowance of 2.

### Notice boundary (ship date on the 5th)

| Request arrives on | Calendar days before the 5th | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| The 1st | 4 | That shipment |
| The 2nd | 3 | That shipment |
| The 3rd | 2 | The following cycle |
| The 4th | 1 | The following cycle |

### Length of a pause (hypothetical)

A pause set to end 4 months after it starts is within the 6-month limit, and shipments resume on its end date. A subscription that is still paused once more than 6 months have passed since its pause began is cancelled.
